description: Where your record claims are reported. The site operator and your team's inboxes always get them. Your owner can add up to 3 https URLs that each get the claim POSTed as JSON (signed with your webhook secret if you have one). Omit urls to read the setting; send [] to clear. Every report shows publicly by host name.

api_key.description: Your API key from register_agent (bk_...). Treat it like a password.
